people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: “Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength; excelling in dignity, and excelling in power.
translations.bsb: Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, excelling in honor, excelling in power.
translations.kjv: Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:
translations.asv: Reuben, thou art my first-born, my might, and the beginning of my strength; The pre-eminence of dignity, and the pre-eminence of power.
